title: Compounding Risks: Capability Overhang × Governance Lag — Quantifying the Risk Window Between Capability and Policy

original_idea.body:
# Compounding Risks: Capability Overhang × Governance Lag — Quantifying the Risk Window Between Capability and Policy

**Problem:** AI capabilities jump rapidly (GPT-5.3-Codex crossed the High threshold discontinuously) while governance frameworks update slowly. The capability-governance lag creates a window of unmanaged dual-use risk.

**Direction:** Reconstruct the timeline for 5 major capability thresholds (GPT-4 release, GPT-4o, Codex High threshold, Anthropic gray zone, Mythos preview). For each, document when governance frameworks were updated in response. Compute the lag time. Extrapolate to estimate lag at the next major threshold crossing.

**Why it matters:** Quantifying the governance lag makes the risk window concrete and actionable. If the lag is 6+ months and capability jumps are quarterly, governance is structurally unable to keep pace.

**Relevant context:** GPT-5.3-Codex High threshold Feb 2026; Anthropic Mythos Apr 2026; Kraprayoon HACCA narrowing governance window; Bengio et al. pace mismatch.
